newsitem.title: USA: Reinsurance Group sets stock guidelines.
newsitem.headline: Reinsurance Group sets stock guidelines.

text.p: Reinsurance Group of America Inc said its board established stock ownership guidelines, to be phased in over time, for its executive management group, which plans to increase its ownership in the company by exercising stock options.

The life reinsurance company said it will grant partial replacement stock options, at current market price, to certain executives who exercise their existing options and agree to hold a portion of the shares acquired for a specified period of time.

Participation by all eligible executives could involve up to about 130,000 shares of Reinsurance Group shares being sold in the market by the executives to finance the exercise of their options and for payment of related taxes.
